name: skills
one_liner: Anthropic's own official library of example add-ons that teach Claude how to do specialized tasks like making documents or following a brand style guide.
buyer: Not really a commercial product on its own — it's a reference/demo repository for developers building on Claude, not something with a paying customer.
business_use_cases: A software vendor studies these examples to build and sell their own custom skill for a vertical (e.g. legal contract review) inside Claude.
An enterprise IT team uses the patterns here as a template for writing internal, company-specific skills for their staff's Claude access.
A consultant uses the document-creation skills shown here as a starting point for a client's automated reporting pipeline.

money_ideas.idea: Use these patterns as a foundation to build and sell a niche, paid Claude skill (e.g. industry-specific compliance checklists) on a marketplace.

steal_this: This weekend, pick one under-served niche (e.g. real-estate listing descriptions) and build a paid custom skill using this repo's template as the starting structure.
